description: Adds the Git actions missing from VS Code's built-in Source Control Graph: amend any commit (reword, change author or date, add staged changes), fixup, squash, drop and revert commits, merge, rebase, reset, and manage branches and tags. No extra view.
command.reset: Reset Current Branch to This Commit...
command.rebase: Rebase Current Branch on This Commit...
command.fixup: Add Staged Changes to This Commit
command.squash: Squash Commits from Here to HEAD...
